text:
marta: Quick prototype idea — a 'Throttle Sim' overlay on the cost dashboard to replay token-burst events and show projected throttle / queueing + cache savings over time.
sam: Nice. Is this just visualization or will it drive routing policy params?
marta: Visualization first. But we want a 'what-if' slider that updates route-level quota/burst and shows estimated token-cost delta and expected fallback model switches.
arjun: We need deterministic replay inputs: per-request token estimate + prefix cache-hit flag. Can we reuse the token telemetry ingest?
mila: We already emit est_tokens and cache_hit in telemetry but sampling is inconsistent. I can produce a sampled denormalized stream for the sim (week/day/hour windows).
tiff: UX: keep tenant-level views gated. Default to aggregated percentiles and an anonymized waterfall. Toggle to reveal tenant preview for SRE/ENG only.
marta: Also debating internal API for getting routing decisions for a specific trace. Options: header-based debug vs separate readonly endpoint. Thoughts?
sam: Prefer a readonly endpoint: GET /internal/v1/route_decision?trace_id=xxx. Headers feel noisy and risk leaking to customers.
arjun: Readonly endpoint adds load to control plane if used at scale. Could make it async: submit replay job -> store snapshot -> UI pulls.
marta: Agreed. MVP: no live control-plane hits per UI action. Replay engine ingests sampled telemetry and materializes decision snapshots. UI toggles will re-run local sim on those snapshots.
mila: I can emit a compact replay record like: ```
{ts: 2024-11-05T12:34:56Z, path_hash: "abc123", est_tokens: 412, cache_hit: true, selected_model: "redwood-13b-q4", latency_ms: 120}
``` and an hourly bundle for the UI.
sam: For cost calc we need model-SKU unit costs and pre/post-cache token counts. Where does that live?
arjun: Model SKU pricing lives in billing-service. We should pull a cached copy into the sim service to avoid cross-service latency.
marta: UX specifics: overlay lines for (1) real token burn, (2) estimated token burn under new quota, (3) cache savings waterfall, (4) fallback count and expected latency regressions. Slider steps: burst (0-5x), steady quota (%) and fallback threshold (latency or queue depth).
tiff: Also add a small 'explain' panel showing which requests caused most cost delta (anonymized hashes).
deploy-bot: Rolling deploy scheduled: replay-api v0.1 -> staging at 2024-11-06T19:30:00Z. :rocket:
marta: Demo in eng-platform sync tomorrow. Please flag red lines: privacy, perf, billing-consistency. :eyes:
